precondition: No provider record exists.
expected_result: Fasti creates one stable entity that remains usable with no external identifier.

precondition: Entity has IMDb only.
expected_result: The Fasti entity ID and Chronicle links do not change.

precondition: Entity displays TMDB metadata and also has TVDB.
expected_result: Only metadata projection changes; entity ID and Chronicle interpretation stay fixed.

precondition: API client stores a Fasti entity URL.
expected_result: The same API URL resolves to the entity.

precondition: External identity is active.
action: Mark the external ID stale after verified 404.
expected_result: Entity remains active; stale state and last success are visible.

precondition: Accepted assertion is later known wrong.
expected_result: Assertion remains auditable, is excluded from new resolution, and prior decisions list its use.

precondition: External ID is retired with a replacement.
expected_result: Old identifier resolves through a terminating redirect and is never reused.

precondition: Two tombstones exist.
action: Attempt to create a redirect cycle.
expected_result: Validation rejects the cycle with a stable error.

precondition: Two entities were merged by reviewed decision.
expected_result: It redirects to the survivor and preserves merge lineage.

precondition: One entity needs to be split.
expected_result: New entities are created with lineage; original observations remain and interpretations are explicitly reassigned or unresolved.

precondition: Import carries an unknown provider ID.
expected_result: Fasti preserves namespace, raw ID, source route and source row without claiming global equivalence.

precondition: Entity has private source evidence.
expected_result: Archive includes required identity evidence but omits secrets and disallowed raw payload fields.

precondition: Entity has assertions, revocation and redirect.
action: Backup and restore to a clean instance.
expected_result: All stable IDs and lifecycle behavior remain equivalent.

precondition: Client submits provider ID as resource key.
expected_result: API requires or resolves a Fasti entity and does not expose provider ID as canonical storage key.

precondition: Two requests create the same source-scoped entity concurrently.
action: Submit with same idempotency key and payload digest.
expected_result: One entity and one receipt exist; replay returns the original result.

precondition: SIMKL row contains IMDb and Kitsu but no MAL.
expected_result: Fasti creates or reuses one entity, keeps both IDs and reports no dead result.

precondition: Entity has IMDb and Kitsu.
expected_result: Resolver may use IMDb for lookup while keeping Kitsu for Kitsu-native operations.

precondition: Same entity later receives MAL through a verified bundle.
expected_result: MAL is attached; history and topology remain unchanged.

precondition: MAL candidate conflicts with existing Kitsu topology.
expected_result: Fasti offers identifier-only attach, topology compare, reject and defer; no forced merge.

precondition: Enrichment provider times out.
expected_result: Job retries with backoff, keeps last-known-good data and marks pending/failed without deleting record.

precondition: One source returns 404 and another succeeds.
expected_result: Failed assertion becomes stale; successful claims remain active; one source failure does not blank the record.

precondition: Import contains only title/year and no ID.
expected_result: Fasti creates a candidate or source-scoped unresolved row; it never auto-merges on title.

precondition: Import row has duplicate title but distinct source IDs.
expected_result: Fasti preserves two source records unless exact accepted evidence joins them.

precondition: Provider emits a new external alias field.
expected_result: Adapter creates a candidate assertion with acquisition route; no model migration or direct merge occurs.

precondition: Enrichment found no counterpart in one namespace.
expected_result: Fasti avoids repeated fruitless lookup until reason/version expires or changes.

precondition: Known absence was based on stale source version.
expected_result: Policy may reopen the lookup with an auditable reason.

precondition: No metadata provider is configured.
action: Record and view a custom local item.
expected_result: Title, notes, tags, history and export work; missing art/URL is a valid empty state.

precondition: Entity is unresolved.
expected_result: API fails closed with known IDs, safe state, next actions and doc URL.

precondition: Same unresolved entity has an IMDb alias.
expected_result: API returns an allowed lookup route and marks its purpose and lossiness.

precondition: Several enrichment routes form a cycle.
expected_result: Traversal is bounded and cycle-safe; trace explains skipped path.

precondition: One anime release maps to part of TVDB season 3.
expected_result: Coverage preserves source range, target season and non-zero offset.

precondition: One release spans two target seasons.
expected_result: Two coverage segments survive without flattening.

precondition: One release maps to non-adjacent target ranges.
expected_result: Discontinuous coverage is represented explicitly.

precondition: One source episode equals two target episodes.
expected_result: Link kind expands is accepted and round-trip loss is declared.

precondition: Two source episodes form one target episode.
expected_result: Link kind merges is accepted and no 1:1 approximation occurs.

precondition: A target segment has no source counterpart.
expected_result: Known absence is represented; resolver does not invent a segment.

precondition: Regular episode 1 and special 1 coexist.
expected_result: Numbering spaces keep them distinct.

precondition: Target exposes season and absolute order.
expected_result: Both coordinate spaces are retained and selectable by intent.

precondition: Broadcast order differs from intended order.
expected_result: Ordering variance is explicit and does not redefine identity.

precondition: Two works share a normalized title.
expected_result: Deduplication never joins them, including later imports.

precondition: Theatrical and extended cuts exist.
expected_result: They remain separate entities with a relation and separate history.

precondition: One recap film belongs to two series groupings.
expected_result: One release can belong to multiple groupings without duplication.

precondition: MAL splits specials while AniDB groups them.
expected_result: Fasti represents one-to-many assertions rather than forcing aliases.

precondition: AniList splits a mini anime into parts while MAL merges it.
expected_result: Fasti preserves separate releases and scoped coverage.

precondition: TMDB inserts a recap into the target order.
expected_result: Explicit links preserve the discontinuity; simple offset is rejected.

precondition: Provider moves an episode to another season.
expected_result: New future resolution can change after review; old occurrence interpretation stays pinned.

precondition: Mapping source supplies ratio-based relationship.
expected_result: Ratio is preserved only for compatible intent; exact write fails if individual segment cannot be resolved.

precondition: Mapping chain has two sources with same derivation root.
expected_result: Fasti does not count them as independent evidence.

precondition: Mapping target identifier no longer exists.
expected_result: Impact report flags stale target and blocks automatic activation for that assertion.

precondition: Bundle proposes a transitive merge through related edges.
expected_result: Related edges never participate in identity merge closure.

precondition: Player reports local file and progress but no provider ID.
expected_result: Original file/path fingerprint, device, time and progress are stored; occurrence can remain unresolved.

precondition: Occurrence was initially interpreted as wrong episode.
expected_result: New interpretation is added; original observation and prior interpretation remain auditable.

precondition: Mapping bundle changes episode candidate.
expected_result: Existing occurrence does not move automatically.

precondition: User chooses to reinterpret one occurrence.
expected_result: Only selected occurrence changes current interpretation.

precondition: User previews bulk reinterpretation.
expected_result: No interpretations or assertions change.

precondition: Bulk reinterpretation was applied.
expected_result: Prior current interpretations become active again; audit remains.

precondition: Same operation is retried after timeout.
expected_result: Server returns original receipt and does not create a second occurrence.

precondition: User genuinely watches same item twice.
action: Submit distinct occurrence IDs and session evidence.
expected_result: Two occurrences remain.

precondition: Two devices use same event ID with different payload digest.
expected_result: Conflict is rejected and logged; no ambiguous mutation occurs.

precondition: Private profile has occurrence interpretation.
action: Query from another profile without grant.
expected_result: Request is denied without revealing identity details.

precondition: User exports a support case.
expected_result: Report includes decision trace and safe IDs but excludes secrets and unrelated history.

precondition: Occurrence has three interpretation versions.
expected_result: All versions, actor, reason and current pointer survive.

precondition: TMDB and TVDB have different titles.
expected_result: Two field claims are stored with source, locale, retrieval and validity; projection policy selects one.

precondition: User edits displayed title.
expected_result: User override wins until cleared and provider refresh does not overwrite it.

precondition: Preferred claim expires.
expected_result: Last-known-good claim displays as stale with source and age.

precondition: Provider returns empty title after prior success.
expected_result: Empty result does not erase valid prior claim unless source explicitly declares deletion and policy accepts it.

precondition: Google Books offers localized edition absent from Open Library.
expected_result: Edition candidate and localized claims enter through the same provider contract.

precondition: ISBN edition is attached to a work.
expected_result: Fasti keeps edition and work distinct and does not treat ISBN as work identity.

precondition: MusicBrainz recording appears on two releases.
expected_result: One recording relation can connect to multiple release tracks without collapsing releases.

precondition: Podcast feed URL changes but GUID is stable.
expected_result: Fasti updates URL observation and retains stable podcast identity.

precondition: Game has Steam and GOG products.
expected_result: Fasti keeps one work with provider-specific releases/products and user-selected metadata projection.

precondition: Cache policy is only-save-library.
expected_result: Unselected results do not grow persistent canonical metadata beyond bounded transient cache.

precondition: User clears one provider cache.
expected_result: Disposable claims/cache are cleared or marked for refresh; canonical user state and other provider claims remain.

precondition: User requests metadata dump.
expected_result: Output shows claims, provenance, cache state and redacts secrets.

precondition: No concert record type exists.
action: Define concert type with explicit completion and no progress.
expected_result: Generated API/UI accepts valid records and rejects video-only fields.

precondition: Game type lacks GOG product ID.
action: Define identity field bound to registered GOG namespace.
expected_result: Field can resolve and filter without becoming canonical Fasti ID.

precondition: User creates ordinary text field named provider_id.
expected_result: Fasti blocks identity use until a namespace is registered.

precondition: Field is multi-valued tag with filterable true.
expected_result: Validated values are stored and bounded derived index is updated.

precondition: Field schema changes from integer to string.
expected_result: Migration preview reports affected values and old version remains readable until applied.

precondition: User marks 500 custom fields filterable.
expected_result: Index budget blocks unsafe configuration with exact storage guidance.

precondition: Custom field is added.
expected_result: JSON Schema, OpenAPI, capability docs and UI form metadata update from one definition.

precondition: Add-on contributing field is removed.
expected_result: Stored values remain preserved and visible as inactive/unsupported; no silent deletion.

precondition: Custom field is marked sensitive.
expected_result: Archive follows explicit inclusion policy; diagnostics redact value.

precondition: Two custom namespaces use same display alias.
expected_result: Stable namespace IDs remain distinct and UI asks for qualified selection.

precondition: Floppy database contains duplicate provider rows with shared history.
expected_result: Fasti reports candidates and preserves every history occurrence; no title merge.

precondition: Source import crashes halfway.
expected_result: Job resumes from checkpoint and already accepted rows are not duplicated.

precondition: Same archive is imported twice.
expected_result: Rows are reused/idempotent and report shows no false rewatches.

precondition: Source row is malformed but contains useful raw identifiers.
expected_result: Row is classified invalid_source_record, safely preserved where policy permits, and does not block other rows.

precondition: Source row references deleted provider ID.
expected_result: Fasti records stale external identity and seeks alternates without deleting source history.

precondition: Source has three legitimate rewatch timestamps.
expected_result: Three occurrences remain with original timestamps and source provenance.

precondition: Source has one watched flag but no occurrence timestamp.
expected_result: Watched state is preserved separately; Fasti does not invent a timestamped occurrence.

precondition: Archive includes unresolved assertions and known absence.
expected_result: Unresolved and known-absence states survive exactly.

precondition: User cancels before apply.
expected_result: No canonical state is changed and temporary files follow retention policy.

precondition: Applied import is wrong.
expected_result: Canonical state returns to pre-import equivalence and audit records rollback.

precondition: Device is offline.
expected_result: Occurrence and outbox operation persist immediately; UI says local and pending.

precondition: Network returns after days.
expected_result: Operations are accepted once, ordered, and receipts clear only committed items.

precondition: Cursor has expired.
expected_result: Server returns stable cursor_expired and client rebuilds from snapshot without losing local unacknowledged writes.

precondition: Remote page includes deletion tombstone.
expected_result: Tombstone is committed with page and cursor; absence elsewhere does not delete data.

precondition: Client crashes after state apply before cursor save.
expected_result: Page replays idempotently and cursor advances after commit.

precondition: Two profiles use same device.
expected_result: Authorization and state attribution remain profile-specific.

precondition: User revokes device while it is offline.
expected_result: New operations are rejected; prior accepted history remains.

precondition: OS suspends app with pending outbox.
expected_result: Outbox survives and retries without requiring app to remain foregrounded continuously.

precondition: WebTransport unavailable behind proxy.
expected_result: Capability negotiation selects WebSocket/HTTP fallback with identical durable semantics.

precondition: Progress hint datagram is dropped.
action: Send final checkpoint on reliable channel.
expected_result: Durable resume state uses reliable checkpoint; lost hint does not corrupt history.

precondition: Provider URL resolves to loopback.
expected_result: Governed Network Boundary blocks request before any credential is sent.

precondition: Allowed URL redirects to cloud metadata IP.
expected_result: Redirect destination is revalidated and blocked.

precondition: Bundle signature is invalid.
expected_result: Bundle is rejected and no assertions enter candidate set.

precondition: Bundle has pathological segment fan-out.
expected_result: Schema/resource limit rejects it with source and path.

precondition: Provider configured URL contains secret token.
expected_result: Raw URL/token does not appear in logs, cache keys, metrics or normal export.

precondition: Declarative API Connection tries arbitrary script.
expected_result: Script is rejected; only approved transforms are permitted.

precondition: MCP client requests bulk entity merge.
expected_result: Operation is unavailable or denied; no direct SQL path exists.

precondition: User from workspace A guesses entity ID from workspace B.
expected_result: Authorization returns not found/denied without cross-workspace metadata leak.

precondition: Provider returns JSON beyond depth/size limit.
expected_result: Response is rejected atomically, source health records safe error and prior claims remain.

precondition: MQTT QoS 1 command is delivered twice.
expected_result: Application operation ID deduplicates; one canonical mutation exists.

precondition: Reconciliation queue has one case.
expected_result: All evidence, compare and decision controls are reachable with stable focus.

precondition: Candidate states use icons/colors.
expected_result: Exact, candidate, disputed and stale states have text names and descriptions.

precondition: Import review is interrupted.
expected_result: Job, filter, selected row and decision checkpoint resume.

precondition: No reconciliation cases exist.
expected_result: Empty state explains purpose, safety and when a case will appear.

precondition: No provider or artwork exists.
expected_result: Local title, notes, actions and state render without broken image or required URL.

precondition: Candidate view shows evidence.
expected_result: Outcome and consequence appear first; full provenance is expandable and not hidden.

precondition: User enables reduced motion.
expected_result: No animated graph or essential motion occurs.

action: Run provider scaffold and example fixture.
expected_result: First validated provider response succeeds in target time with one documented command sequence.

expected_result: Error states exact path, expected value, actual value, fix, doc URL and replay command.

precondition: OpenAPI client is generated.
expected_result: Generated SDK uses stable operation ID and typed error model.

precondition: Conformance fixture is rejected.
expected_result: Output names lost capability and why naive format breaks.

expected_result: Current KCS unit explains symptom, safe state, cause, recovery and verification.
